target.title: fix(android): keep link preview metadata UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android link previews cap OpenGraph title and description metadata before rendering compact preview cards. The existing cap used Kotlin `take(maxChars)`, which can leave an unpaired UTF-16 high surrogate when the limit lands between an emoji surrogate pair.

## Why This Change Was Made

Recent main has been tightening bounded text handling so user-visible truncation does not emit invalid UTF-16. Link preview metadata had the same boundary issue and already has focused Robolectric coverage for sanitization and length caps.

## User Impact

Long page titles or descriptions containing emoji at the truncation boundary are now clipped before the surrogate pair instead of preserving a malformed character in Android chat link previews.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local` -> `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`
- From `apps/android`:
  - `.\gradlew.bat :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests "ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatLinkPreviewTest" --console=plain` -> passed
  - `.\gradlew.bat :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests "ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatLinkPreviewTest" --console=plain` -> `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m 24s`
